subject: Proposal: Efficiency Credits & Modular Discounting for Optimize Toolkit
messages:
From: Aiden Moore <aiden.moore@parcelly.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Parcelly Procurement <procurement@parcelly.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: Optimize toolkit, discounts for pilot & procurement timeline

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Parcelly is excited to evaluate Redwood's Optimize toolkit as part of our pilot later this quarter. A few concrete asks from procurement and our ML team so we can scope commercially: 

- Can you share a pricing structure that separates "efficiency credits" (batching + cache) from raw per-token billing? Procurement prefers a line-item we can show in the SOW.
- Do you have standard discount bands for pilot-to-production commits (90-day pilot -> annual commit)? What's the discount floor and any eligibility conditions (e.g., minimum commit, ROI targets)?
- From an ML perspective: recommended quantization profiles for real-time inference (latency <= 200 ms) vs batch inference (higher throughput) and whether those affect pricing tiers.
- We also need SOC2 evidence and a simple billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).

I attached our RFP Q&A and a short usage sample. Can you put together an initial commercial proposal + suggested technical constraints we can give to procurement by next Wednesday (May 12)?

Best,
Aiden Moore
Head of ML Product — Parcelly
Aiden.Moore@parcelly.ai
Attachment: Parcelly_RFP_Q&A.pdf (PDF)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aiden Moore <aiden.moore@parcelly.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Inquiry: Optimize toolkit, discounts for pilot & procurement timeline

Hi Aiden — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise commercial framework we can turn into a one-page offer for procurement. Marcus, please add any technical clarifications.

Commercial summary (draft):
- Efficiency Credits: sell as prepaid units that redeem for batching/caching optimizations. Credits applied to Optimize runtime features (prefix cache, KV cache warming, intelligent batching).
- Pricing model: credits + per-token for model compute. Credits reduce per-token effective cost when used.
- Pilot program: up to 90 days, one-time pilot discount of 25% on credits for first 90 days, capped at a $50k credit value unless a committed follow-on is signed.
- Commit bands (Annual): tiered discounts on credits: 0-250k credits (base price), 250k-1M (+8% discount), 1M+ (+15% discount). Additional 10% incentive for 12-mo commit if invoiced annually.
- Quantization allowance: models serving in INT8/Q4 formats eligible for a quantization premium discount (5% off credits) if Redwood-verified accuracy regressions are within agreed thresholds.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices. Procurement can request quarterly invoicing for committed deals.

Next steps: I will prepare a one-page commercial with line items separated for credits, per-token, and optional private deployment add-on. Marcus — any strong constraints from performance/accuracy side we should call out?

Neha Kapoor
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aiden Moore <aiden.moore@parcelly.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Inquiry: Optimize toolkit, discounts for pilot & procurement timeline

Hi — quick technical notes to include in the offer (keeps expectations aligned):

- Target latency <= 200 ms (p50) — recommend: quantized INT8 for LLMs up to 7B, and Q4_0 for 13B+ when latency is strict. INT8 typically reduces cost by ~30% with minimal accuracy hit on our benchmarks.
- Batching: set a soft batching window 20-40 ms for interactive flows; batching yields best throughput when request concurrency >= 8.
- Prefix/KV cache: recommend a "warm-up" of 5–10 requests per conversation to reach steady-state cache hit rates. Offer: include 10k prefix cache units as part of pilot credits for evaluation.
- Fallbacks: if quantization causes model quality regressions beyond agreed test prompts, we will auto-fallback to higher-precision variant and those tokens will bill at the standard per-token rate; credits are not consumed for fallbacks beyond a 48-hr remediation window.
- On-prem/private pricing: adds a fixed platform fee + reduced per-token compute rate (depends on infra amortization). We'll include a separate line.

I'll provide estimated tokens/min and cost-per-req examples for Parcelly's sample workload once you confirm the model family and expected concurrency.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: efficiency_credits_pricing_v2.xlsx (Excel)

- We need a discrete line for private deployment licensing (we may test on-prem for compliance). Please include a standard platform fee number + an example infra cost assumption for our SOW.
- Pilot cap: the $50k cap sounds reasonable. Will you confirm that the 25% pilot discount only applies to credits and not per-token compute? Procurement flagged that.
- Can you draft a DocuSign-ready SOW and include SOC2 attestation (or link to your compliance package)?

If you can get a draft offer + DocuSign by EOD Friday (May 14), procurement can route for approval Monday.

—Aiden

Subject: RE: Inquiry: Optimize toolkit, discounts for pilot & procurement timeline

Aiden — looping in Grace from Customer Success and confirming commercial concessions. We've approved the following for Parcelly (terms summarized):

- Pilot: 90-day pilot with 25% discount applied to efficiency credits only, cap $50,000 credits. Per-token compute billed at list during pilot.
- Commit incentive: if Parcelly signs a 12-month committed purchase within 30 days of pilot end, an additional 10% discount on credits will be applied retroactively to pilot consumption (not to per-token compute).
- Commit bands: as discussed by Neha — 8% discount at 250k+ credits, 15% at 1M+. Additional 10% for annual prepay.
- Private deployment: standard platform fee is $40k/month (one-time onboarding fee waived for pilots), with model compute priced per negotiated infra amortization (we included an example in the attached spreadsheet).

Attachments: revised pricing and a one-page SOW are attached (efficiency_credits_pricing_v2.xlsx; redwood_optimize_tiers.pdf). We will prepare a DocuSign envelope and link it to the HubSpot deal DL-PL-2027-04572.

Next steps: Neha/Grace will send the DocuSign SOW + SOC2 compliance link by EOD Friday. Procurement — once signed, please return a PO referencing DL-PL-2027-04572.

Thanks — Sofia
